opportunity.title: Jury Management Solution (JMS) System (Presolicitation)
opportunity.agency: Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts
opportunity.description: Pre-solicitation notice for a web-based Jury Management System for the Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts. The solicitation is unrestricted and not set aside for small business; the Judiciary is not subject to the FAR small business regulations. The AO plans a single-award IDIQ for a commercial off-the-shelf web-based jury management solution that supports selecting, managing and tracking jurors, performs financial and statistical calculations, and interfaces with the Judiciary's financial management system, Momentum. The draft solicitation USCA27R0009 gives requirements and evaluation criteria. The due time is listed as TBD.

rationale.point: The opportunity is a presolicitation (market research) with no contract awarded yet, so responding now is low-cost and could position Atlas for future solicitation.
Atlas Federal is a large business with relevant NAICS 541511 and no set-aside restriction (set-aside NONE), making it eligible per the eligibility gate.

Established competitors Tyler Technologies and i3 Verticals offer mature, widely deployed jury management solutions, and market consolidation is occurring, indicating strong competition for a niche product.

Atlas Federal lacks specific past performance in jury management systems (profile mentions DoD/civilian IT and Defense Health Agency data program, not courts), and the agency has zero prior awards in this NAICS, so no incumbency advantage.

risks: Strong competition from vendors with proven COTS jury management systems deployed in 30+ states.
Market consolidation may reduce opportunities for new entrants.
Uncertainty of presolicitation: requirements, timeline, and acquisition strategy unknown.
Atlas Federal's lack of domain-specific past performance may weaken proposal.
nextSteps: Respond to presolicitation to express interest and request more details on requirements and acquisition strategy.
Evaluate teaming with a jury management COTS vendor (e.g., Tyler Technologies or i3 Verticals) to combine integration expertise with product.
Assess feasibility and cost of custom development vs. COTS integration.
